svg.text: All 23 locations × 14 manuscript codices; Cairo is shown separately as a printed comparator.
h = h-shaped ending t = t-shaped ending * = later-hand bracketed cell
Dark = no reading reported; C = 1924 Cairo comparator, not an early codex.
Source: Van Putten (2019), Table 2, p. 278; verified against the prior project’s reproduced table.
